title: MicroHealth Named a 2025 Top Workplace for Culture and Well-being
summary: MicroHealth LLC named a 2025 Top Workplace for employee appreciation, professional development, and well-being.
body_text: By Trinity Cyrus | Oct 22, 2025 Vienna, Virginia – MicroHealth LLC, a leading Information Technology company and recognized as one of the best IT companies to work for, is proud to announce its recognition in the 2025 Top Workplaces Fall Culture Excellence Awards. The company earned honors in Employee Appreciation, Professional Development, and Employee Well-being. Presented by Energage , these awards are based on confidential employee feedback and celebrate organizations that create cultures where people feel valued, supported, and motivated to succeed. “ Our people are the foundation of MicroHealth’s success,” said Frank Tucker, CEO of MicroHealth LLC. “These recognitions reinforce our commitment to fostering a workplace that prioritizes growth, well-being, and appreciation.” 2025 Top Workplace for Employee Appreciation MicroHealth makes employee recognition a core part of its culture through Employee of the Month honors, Impact Awards, and company-wide celebrations. The headquarters includes an in-house café, game room, and wellness spaces that make work engaging and rewarding. For those who prefer flexibility, MicroHealth also offers remote and hybrid work options. Employee Well-being: 2025 Top Workplace MicroHealth promotes total well-being through competitive health benefits that include medical, dental, vision, and pet insurance. The company also offers flexible leave policies and wellness programs that support both physical and mental health. 2025 Top Workplace for Professional Development With initiatives like MicroHealth University, tuition assistance, and a Financial Wellness program, MicroHealth invests in long-term employee growth. The company also offers paid internships and mentoring opportunities to help emerging professionals build rewarding careers in health IT. These awards reaffirm MicroHealth’s position as a Top Workplace and a Service-Disabled, Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) that champions both innovation and inclusion. What Employees are Saying MicroHealth’s well-rounded employee benefits are only one part of the strong workplace culture the company has built. Employees describe their experience as both empowering and rewarding. One shared, “I love the work that I do, and the people I support value what I do.” Another noted, “I am given the autonomy to manage my daily work, but still given the support I need.” Others emphasized a spirit of mentorship, saying, “I actively work to mentor and teach members of my team.” About the Award The Top Workplaces program, powered by Energage, has a 17-year history of recognizing people-first organizations across the nation and in more than 60 regional markets. The Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Awards honor companies that excel in key areas of workplace culture, such as employee appreciation, professional development, and well-being. All awards are based solely on feedback gathered through a research-backed employee engagement survey, providing an authentic measure of how employees experience their workplace. “Earning a Top Workplaces award is a badge of honor for companies, especially because it comes authentically from their employees,” said Eric Rubino, CEO of Energage. “In today’s market, leaders must ensure employees have a voice and are heard. That’s paramount. Top Workplaces do this, and it pays dividends.” Now that we have your attention MicroHealth is a service-disabled, Veteran-owned small business making a BIG impact in federal IT . From agile project management and advanced cybersecurity to generative AI , data analytics , software development , and more, we deliver secure, innovative solutions for government agencies and the Uniformed Services. We’re proud to be a five-time Top Workplace USA winner. See more of our awards at microhealthllc.com/about-us/awards . Stay connected with us on LinkedIn for the latest news and stories. title: Escalade Reports Third Quarter 2025 Results
summary: /PRNewswire/ -- Escalade, Inc. (NASDAQ: ESCA, or the "Company"), a leading manufacturer and distributor of sporting goods and indoor/outdoor recreational...
body_text: EVANSVILLE, Ind. , Oct. 30, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Escalade, Inc. (NASDAQ: ESCA , or the "Company"), a leading manufacturer and distributor of sporting goods and indoor/outdoor recreational equipment, today announced third quarter of 2025 results. THIRD QUARTER 2025 HIGHLIGHTS (As compared to the third quarter 2024) Net sales of $67.8 million compared to $67.7 million Gross margin of 28.1% of net sales compared to 24.8% Operating income of $7.3 million compared to $8.0 million Net income of $5.6 million, or $0.40 earnings per diluted share, compared to $5.7 million, or $0.40 earnings per diluted share EBITDA of $8.6 million compared to $9.9 million Ratio of net debt to trailing twelve-months EBITDA of 0.7x as of September 30, 2025 compared to 1.1x as of September 30, 2024 For the third quarter ended September 30, 2025, Escalade reported net sales of $67.8 million, net income of $5.6 million and diluted earnings per share of $0.40. Total net sales increased 0.1% on a year-over-year basis in the third quarter, primarily due to increased sales within the archery, table tennis, billiards and safety categories, partially offset by softer market demand in our basketball category as well as the strategic exit of certain categories. Escalade reported a third quarter gross margin of 28.1%, an increase of 334 basis points versus the prior-year period, primarily driven by lower fixed costs and decreased inventory storage and handling costs, partially offset by tariff-related costs. Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization ("EBITDA") decreased $1.3 million to $8.6 million in the third quarter 2025, versus $9.9 million in the prior-year period. The decrease in EBITDA compared to the third quarter of last year was due to a $3.9 million non-recurring gain on sale of assets held for sale recognized in the prior-year period, partially offset by improved gross margins recognized in 2025. During the third quarter of 2025, the cash flow used in operating activities was ($0.1) million, compared to cash generated of $10.5 million for the same quarter in 2024. Operating cash flow during the third quarter of 2025 reflected a seasonal buildup in working capital relative to the second quarter in advance of the holiday selling season. Total debt at the end of the quarter was $20.2 million, down 31.4% from $29.5 million at the end of the third quarter last year. As of September 30, 2025, the Company had total cash and equivalents of $3.5 million, together with $60.0 million of availability on its senior secured revolving credit facility maturing in 2027. At the end of the third quarter 2025, net debt (total debt less cash) was 0.7x trailing twelve-month EBITDA. Escalade announced a quarterly dividend of $0.15 per share to be paid to all shareholders of record on January 5, 2026 and payable on January 12, 2026. MANAGEMENT COMMENTARY "We delivered strong third-quarter results, driven by sustained demand for our leading brands and our ongoing commitment to operational excellence," said Patrick J. Griffin, Escalade's Interim President and Chief Executive Officer. "Our results are especially encouraging given the challenging macro environment, where ongoing economic and geopolitical uncertainty continues to impact consumer spending patterns for discretionary goods." "Our third quarter revenue reflected favorable demand across several of our core categories, including safety, table tennis, archery and billiards," continued Griffin. "We gained market share, particularly in our safety and archery categories, supported by the strength of our domestic manufacturing presence and consistent product availability. Gross margin improved significantly, driven by operational efficiency and targeted price increases in the quarter, which more than offset $4.3 million in tariff-related costs. Our team remains agile and disciplined amid a dynamic trade environment. We're prioritizing supply chain readiness as we enter the peak holiday shopping season." "Looking ahead," added Griffin, "we expect consumers to remain cautious and value-driven. Together with our retail partners, we are executing a balanced promotional strategy during the holiday shopping season that highlights the quality of our brands, while deploying targeted promotions to generate consumer demand and maximize sell-through. Supported by our reduced operational footprint and ongoing cost discipline, we expect to sustain improved gross margin performance, even as consumer demand for discretionary products remains uneven." Griffin concluded, "We remain focused on disciplined capital allocation and profitable growth. During the quarter, we completed the acquisition of Gold Tip, a leading arrow brand for bowhunting and target archery. The acquisition also included the Bee Stinger line of premium bow stabilizers. These two brands expand our archery product portfolio and position us for continued market share gains in the archery category. As we look forward, our strategy remains centered on profitable growth, operational excellence and creating value for our customers and shareholders." title: Seeing the Unseen: How BSIS, MOIS and Smart-Vision® CMS with ADAS Features Transform Urban Bus Safety
summary: Gauzy - Seeing the Unseen: How BSIS, MOIS and Smart-Vision® CMS with ADAS Features Transform Urban Bus Safety - Safety Tech %
body_text: Why integrated Camera Monitoring Systems are the new standard for protecting passengers, drivers and vulnerable road users. Buses are the backbone of urban mobility, carrying millions of passengers daily through increasingly complex city environments. But the rise of micro mobility, including cyclists, e-bikes, scooters and pedestrians, has transformed the way buses interact with their surroundings. Today, the biggest challenge for public transport fleets is no longer just efficiency. It is safety. In dense urban areas, blind spots remain one of the leading causes of collisions between buses and vulnerable road users (VRUs). Intersections, bus stops and crowded lanes often create critical moments where a pedestrian or cyclist may go unnoticed until it is too late. According to the European Commission, more than half of all cyclist fatalities occur in urban areas, highlighting the urgency of addressing these risks. In New York City, Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA) buses were involved in 35 collisions with e-bikes or e-scooters in 2022, up from 27 in 2021, demonstrating that micro-mobility increases exposure to incidents. Similarly, pedestrian injuries involving buses and vans alongside micro-mobility sources numbered over 220 per year, emphasizing the growing challenge for fleet safety.

title: U.S. Army Major General (Ret.) Patrick Roberson Joins Reach’s Government Advisory Board
summary: Former USASOC Deputy CG Patrick Roberson joins Reach Power’s advisory board, guiding fielding of safe RF wireless power-at-a-distance for mission systems.
body_text: U.S. Army Major General (Ret.) Patrick Roberson Joins Reach’s Government Advisory Board October 8, 2025 – Redwood City, Calif – Reach Power (Reach), the leader in wireless power-at-a-distance, today announced the appointment of U.S. Army Major General (Ret.) Patrick B. Roberson to its Government Advisory Board. Roberson most recently served as Deputy Commanding General, U.S. Army Special Operations Command (USASOC) and has over 34 years of service. He joins an experienced group of advisors that includes U.S. Army Major General (Ret.) Clay Hutmacher, former USSOCOM Acquisition Executive Jim Smith, U.S. Navy Rear Admiral (Ret.) Jim Kirk, and former Defense Innovation Unit Energy Portfolio Director Benjamin Richardson. Reach develops wireless power beaming systems that enable persistent operations of electronic devices. Its wireless power transfer technology (WPT) uses radio frequency (RF) energy to power numerous, moving, and hard-to-reach devices such as unattended ground sensors (UGS), small unmanned aerial systems (sUAS), ground robots and other electronic equipment. This technology reduces dependency on foreign-made batteries and the need for manual battery management. “Operational energy is now a pacing factor,” said Maj. Gen. (Ret.) Patrick Roberson. “As unmanned and autonomous systems proliferate, units need ways to keep sensors, drones, and edge devices powered without adding risk or logistics burden. I’m excited to help Reach accelerate fielding of wireless power where it matters most.” “Maj. Gen. Roberson brings hard-won special operations forces and joint experience at the tactical and institutional levels,” said Chris Davlantes, Founder & CEO of Reach. “His perspective on readiness, training pipelines, and combat employment will help us align our tech and transition pathways with real-world mission needs.” Roberson holds an M.S. in Defense Analysis from the Naval Postgraduate School, an M.A. in Strategic Studies from the Army School of Advanced Military Studies, complemented by executive coursework in leadership and strategic thinking from the UNC Kenan-Flagler Business School. Roberson previously commanded the U.S. Army John F. Kennedy Special Warfare Center and School (USAJFKSWCS), overseeing the training and education of Special Forces, Psychological Operations, and Civil Affairs forces, and led Special Operations Joint Task Force–Operation Inherent Resolve in Iraq and Syria, contributing to the defeat of ISIS’s physical caliphate in 2019. His awards include the Army Distinguished Service Medal (DSM), Defense Superior Service Medal (DSSM), Legion of Merit, Bronze Star, and various other unit and service awards. About Reach Reach develops wireless power-beaming systems that deliver safe, targeted RF energy over distance to keep unattended ground sensors (UGS), sUAS, ground robots, and other electronic equipment persistent and mission-ready without cables or frequent battery swaps. The technology reduces logistics burden and dependence on foreign battery supply chains across defense, public safety, and industrial markets. It’s within Reach. title: The Importance of Permanent Magnet Motors
summary: The Importance of Permanent Magnet Motors
body_text: Permanent magnet motors (PM motors) are important due to several advantages and benefits they offer across various applications. Advantages of Permanent Magnet Motors: High Efficiency – PM motors typically offer higher efficiency compared to traditional motors because they do not require energy to magnetize the rotor. Higher efficiency means lower energy consumption, which is crucial for reducing operational costs and environmental impact. Compact and Lightweight Design – The use of permanent magnets allows for more compact and lighter motor designs. This is particularly valuable in applications where space and weight are critical factors, such as in electric vehicles (EVs) and aerospace applications. High Power Density – PM motors provide a high power-to-weight ratio, meaning they can deliver more power relative to their size and weight. High power density makes them suitable for high-performance applications like electric vehicles, drones, and industrial robots. Improved Performance – PM motors have better torque characteristics, providing consistent and high torque across a wide speed range. Enhanced performance is essential for applications requiring precise control and high torque, such as robotics, CNC machines, and servo drives. Reduced Maintenance – PM motors have fewer components that wear out over time compared to induction motors, which reduces the need for regular maintenance. Lower maintenance requirements translate into reduced downtime and operational costs, making PM motors more reliable and cost-effective in the long run. Better Dynamic Response – PM motors exhibit superior dynamic response due to their lower inertia and direct control over the magnetic field. Fast and accurate response times are critical for applications in automation, robotics, and precision manufacturing. Energy Savings – The high efficiency and performance of PM motors contribute to significant energy savings. Energy savings are crucial for reducing overall energy consumption, lowering carbon footprints, and adhering to environmental regulations. Quiet Operation – PM motors operate more quietly compared to other motor types due to the absence of brushes and lower friction components. Quiet operation is essential in applications such as household appliances, medical devices, and office equipment, where noise reduction is a priority. Versatility – PM motors can be used in a wide range of applications, from small electronic devices to large industrial machines. Their versatility makes them suitable for diverse industries, including automotive, aerospace, consumer electronics, healthcare, and industrial automation. Higher Reliability – The robustness of PM motors, due to fewer mechanical parts and the use of high-quality materials, enhances their reliability. High reliability is crucial for critical applications where failure is not an option, such as in medical equipment, aerospace systems, and critical infrastructure. Applications for Permanent Magnet Motors: Electric Vehicles (EVs) – PM motors are widely used in EVs for propulsion due to their high efficiency, compact size, and excellent performance characteristics. Industrial Automation – In automation and robotics, PM motors provide precise control, high torque, and reliable performance, making them ideal for manufacturing and assembly processes. Household Appliances – PM motors are used in appliances like refrigerators, washing machines, and air conditioners, offering energy-efficient and quiet operation. Renewable Energy – PM motors are used in wind turbines and other renewable energy systems for efficient energy conversion and generation. Aerospace – In aerospace applications, PM motors contribute to weight reduction and improved performance in systems like actuators and control surfaces. Medical Devices – PM motors are used in medical equipment such as MRI machines, ventilators, and surgical tools for their precision, reliability, and quiet operation. Conclusion: Permanent magnet motors play a crucial role in modern technology due to their superior efficiency, compactness, high power density, and reliability. Their importance spans a wide range of applications, contributing to advancements in electric vehicles, industrial automation, household appliances, renewable energy, aerospace, and medical devices. As technology continues to evolve, PM motors will remain a key component in the drive towards more efficient, sustainable, and high-performance solutions. title: Fall Car Care Month: Why a Car Wash Belongs in Your Seasonal Routine
summary: Prepare your vehicle for fall with seasonal car care tips and regular washes that help protect your car and improve road safety.
body_text: As the seasons shift in October, it’s a great time to focus on preventative maintenance for your vehicle. While many people think about checking their tires or wiper blades this time of year, a weekly car wash is just as essential to your car care routine. At Mister Car Wash , we believe a clean car is more than a shine—it’s a step toward safety, longevity, and peace of mind on the road. As the weather changes, so do driving conditions. Wet leaves, early storms, and shorter days can all affect your daily commute. By giving your car the attention it needs now, you’re setting yourself up for a safer and smoother driving season ahead. Tire Tread Awareness: When you stop to vacuum at the wash, take a moment to inspect your tires. Worn tread can make it harder to stop on wet, slick, and leaf-covered roads. Windshield & Wipers: Seasonal storms call for streak-free visibility. Replacing wipers and keeping your windshield clean reduces glare from the lower-setting sun, especially during evening commutes Headlights & Visibility: Dirty headlights can reduce your visibility by up to 50%. A professional wash helps remove dirt and debris, allowing you to see—and be seen—more clearly. Routine washes do more than keep your car looking good. They actively protect your vehicle. Mister Car Wash localizes each wash to your region’s climate and road conditions—whether it’s dust, pollen, rain, snow, or road salt—so your car receives the protection it needs where you drive most. By removing harmful contaminants before they cause damage, we help preserve your paint, protect against corrosion, and extend the life of your vehicle’s finish. Paint & Finish Protection: Road grime, pollen, and even ocean salt can damage your paint over time. Washing and getting our protectant product create a barrier against fall weather and the months ahead. Undercarriage Care: Summer road trips can leave behind layers of road grime, environmental contaminates, brake dust, and dirt. A thorough undercarriage wash helps remove buildup before it causes corrosion. Better Longevity: As the AAA notes , regular washing is essential to keeping it in top-notch shape—making a wash not just cosmetic, but a good investment. Best Practice: Wash Before the Weather Turns The best time to wash your car is before the start of the season. By removing debris and applying protection now, you help your car withstand what’s ahead. It’s one of the simplest, smartest ways to keep your car safe, strong, and shining through the months to come. So, this October, make Mister Car Wash part of your vehicle maintenance routine. Stop by, reset your vehicle for the season, and drive with confidence into the cooler months.
